answer_1.quote: We aim to generate the repaired code and the commit message based on the given buggy code... we propose the novel task of jointly repairing code and generating commit message.

answer_2.quote: For the code repair, we use exact match accuracy to measure the percentage of the predicted fixed code that are exactly matching the truth fixed code. In addition, we also introduce the BLEU-4 score as a supplementary metric... For the commit message generation, we use BLEU-4 and ROUGE-L to evaluate our model.
